question: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting clockwise around a circular table in the same sequence at equal distances between them. All are facing the centre of the table. If E is sitting in the north-west, then in which direction is G facing?
solution:
**Given : **

 
• **Eight persons - A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H **
 
• ****
 
• **All are facing the center of the table.**

**Explanation :**

 
• E is sitting in the north-west :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e21838a42b45ad8b70753cd04f3bf16f4e731c5eaddac3e61c93780814be70bf.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, G is in the South-West direction.

Hence, "South-West" is the correct answer.
